lines.1: Under the blazing sun, we just swam and swam!
lines.6: 「Pwah... Could that be a sea bream?」
lines.9: She was already way out there.
lines.11: 「Piece of cake. What, can't you keep up?」
lines.13: 「There's a jellyfish just ahead and off to the side, so watch out.」
lines.15: 「Wait, wait! If there's a jellyfish around, I'm going first!」
lines.17: We swam in a wide loop around Ikajima.
lines.18: 「Hey, there's something that looks like a turban shell down here.」
lines.19: 「There's a pretty shell down below me too!」
lines.20: 「All right, let's see who can grab the coolest shell.」
lines.21: 「You're on. ...I should've gone after shells instead of fish yesterday.」
lines.24: 「There aren't any rocks, so you're my rest stop.」
lines.25: Konoe grabbed onto me while I was treading water.
lines.26: 「Whoa, weighing me down? That's a pretty subtle attack.」
lines.27: 「What, don't tell me you're giving up.」
lines.28: 「Not a chance. Rest as long as you want.」
lines.31: 「Then let's see you swim while pulling me along.」
lines.33: I swam on, pulling Konoe by the hand.
lines.35: She was having the time of her life.
